name: Cancel Non Deliverable Forward Valuation V 02
definition: Scope|The CancelNonDeliverableForwardValuation message is sent by a participant to a central system or to a counterparty to notify the cancellation of the valuation of a non deliverable trade previously confirmed by the sender.|Usage|The message will contain a Related Reference to link it to the previously sent notification. It may contain a reason for cancellation.

TradeInformation.name: Trade Information
TradeInformation.definition: Provides references and date of the valuation of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.

TradingSideIdentification.name: Trading Side Identification
TradingSideIdentification.definition: Specifies the trading side of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.

CounterpartySideIdentification.name: Counterparty Side Identification
CounterpartySideIdentification.definition: Specifies the counterparty of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.

TradeAmounts.name: Trade Amounts
TradeAmounts.definition: Specifies the amounts of the valuation of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.

ValuationRate.name: Valuation Rate
ValuationRate.definition: Specifies the valuation rate of the valuation of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.

ValuationInformation.name: Valuation Information
ValuationInformation.definition: Specifies the valuation information of the valuation of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.
